entities.summary: Ilze Jaunalksne-Rēdere, is a Latvian journalist and an author and anchor of the TV3 Latvia current affairs program Nekā personīga since 2008. From 2005 to 2008 she was an anchor for the Latvian Television channel LTV1 current affairs program De Facto.
